A.3 Matching rules
Thai keywordCase-sensitive substring match. Thai has no word delimiters, so no boundary test applies.
Latin keywordCase-insensitive, must sit on a token boundary (`[^a-z0-9]` or string edge both sides) so `BET` does not match betterment.
Mixed keywordSubstring match, e.g. สล็อต pg.
Hashtag keywordMatch the full string including `#`, then strip the `#` and re-run the remainder against the product categories, so #สล็อต also scores Slots.
Two-letter abbreviationsPG PP FC XO SA WM AG AE count only when the token stands alone or sits at a separator inside a domain stem (`pg-slot`, `slotxo`, `/pg/`). High false-positive risk.
Cross-category collisionsคาสิโน · คาสิโนออนไลน์ resolve to Casino. พนันกีฬา · พนันบอล · แทงบอล resolve to Football Betting. The specific product category always beats the catch-all.

A.4 Heat map axes

Three heat maps are built from this model. Every one shares the same columns, so they read against each other. Cell intensity is a sequential single-hue scale; a zero cell renders as page background with a hairline border, never as the palest fill, so no data stays distinct from low count.
Keyword × subcategoryRows: top 25 matched keywords (A.1 and A.2). Columns: the 7 product subcategories. Cell: sites matching that keyword within that subcategory.
Signal tag × subcategoryRows: the 7 signal tags (A.2). Columns: the 7 product subcategories. Cell: site count. Shows which products lean on promotional, payment or evasion language.
Brand cluster × subcategoryRows: top 20 brand clusters. Columns: the 7 product subcategories. Cell: URL count. Multi-product operators appear as horizontal bands.
Label orientationUpright on both axes. Long names truncate with an ellipsis and carry the full string in the tooltip; labels are never rotated.
Row / column orderDescending total on each axis.

Fill guide. Status cell: Confirmed · Pending · Dismissed — swap the class to ok, warn or off. Confidence badge: g-a ≥0.90, g-b 0.75–0.89, g-c 0.60–0.74, g-d 0.40–0.59, g-f <0.40. Duplicate a record block for each additional record; the heading carries its title of classification.
